Clarification in respect of Delegation of Administrative and Financial Powers- reg
Sir,
CPFC in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-para 3 of para 24 of the Employees'
Provident Fund Scheme,
1952,
had delegated certain Administrative and Financial Powers to
ACC(Zone) vide Office Order No. HRM-I/D-I6(1)/2006/19564 dated 09.06.2006 (copy enclosed).
It is
hereby clarified that the said delegation is applicable to all ACC(HQ) level Officers in charge of Zones
as well as Director PDNASS. These powers shall be exercised by them in respect of the staff and
other officers under theirjurisdiction in Employees' Provident Fund Organisation as may be the case.
2.
It may be noted that these powers delegated hereunder shall not be re-delegated by them to
any other officer subordinate to them.
(This issues with the approval of CPFC)
Encl: As above.
